attempts.text:
The Kakani temple and Suryagadhi school area is cut off: its only link to the network is the damaged Uttargaya–Kakani road, so everyone there is deferred. The 7 elderly people at Kalika temple and Bidur care home can be reached and rescued.

<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kalika-temple
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 kalika-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car2 thakre-hospital bidur-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 bidur-care-home uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
defer kakani-temple elderly 1
defer kakani-temple adult 4
defer suryagadhi-school child 6
</plan>
COST: 542

Driving totals 52 minutes (car1: 22, car2: 30). Deferral penalties total 490 (6 children × 60, 1 elderly × 50, 4 adults × 20).
